about.subtitle: Me
paragraphs: I am Nguyen Phuc Dai, a software developer passionate about building robust web systems and APIs on the .NET platform. My expertise spans ASP.NET Core, Entity Framework Core, SQL Server, Docker, and ReactJS.
I am always seeking opportunities to learn, improve my skills, and build high-quality software products that deliver real value to users.
